description: Figure 6 (left) is a pie chart showing the distribution of data sources in the combined training set, with 13 slices labeled around the chart and connected by leader lines; the slices are colored in distinct hues (including a large blue segment, teal/cyan segments, orange, red/pink, and several small green/yellow segments). The labeled categories and approximate percentages shown are NQ (blue, 31.3%), FEVER (teal, 16.1%), SNLI (orange, 15.4%), VITAMINC (light cyan, 13.0%), MULTINLI (pink/red, 9.0%), SCITAIL (salmon, 8.0%), SQUADMU (very small slice, 1.6%), TACRED (very small slice, 1.6%), ENTA (very small slice, 1.6%), SIFACT (very small slice, 1.6%), ANLI (very small slice, 0.8%), MULTIFC (very small slice, 0.5%), and PUBHEALTH (very small slice, 0.5%). There is no separate legend and no percentages printed inside the slices; labels and percentages are placed outside the pie, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
